mechanism: Both are corticosteroids with additive systemic absorption and immunosuppressive effects, particularly when fluticasone is inhaled/intranasal and prednisolone ophthalmic is used concurrently.
action: Monitor for signs of systemic corticosteroid effects (hyperglycemia, immunosuppression, HPA axis suppression); consider alternative non-corticosteroid ophthalmic agents or adjust dosing of one agent if prolonged concurrent use is necessary.
